entities.name: Apepei
entities.description: Dwarf advisor to Lord Peemel of Iwset, secret lover and later husband of Lady Edara.

entities.name: Peemel
entities.description: Lord of Iwset who declared war on Jehesic after Edara refused his proposal.

entities.name: Iwset
entities.description: City-state in Terisiare where Apepei served.

entities.name: Jehesic
entities.description: Island realm ruled by Lady Edara.

entities.name: Edara
entities.description: Ruler of Jehesic and Apepei's secret lover.

entities.name: Digody
entities.description: Apepei's arch-rival advisor who stabbed Peemel and was killed by Apepei.

entities.name: Ferantia
entities.description: Sorceress who betrayed Edara and was killed by Apepei.

entities.name: Coernn
entities.description: Sorcerer set up as a spy among Vervamon's soldier band.

entities.name: Yunnie
entities.description: Heir of Iwset and son of Peemel's late wife; smashed the Sigil of Iwset.

entities.name: Sigil of Iwset
entities.description: Sigil of rulership of Iwset smashed by Yunnie.

entities.name: Ehno
entities.description: Killed the traitor Feyne and put the sigil in Yunnie's hands.

events.summary: Peemel declares war on Jehesic after Edara refuses his proposal.
events.quote: declared war on Jehesic after Edara refused Peemel's marriage proposal

events.summary: Apepei kills Ferantia before she can compel Edara.
events.quote: killed Ferantia with his sword before she could finish her plan

events.summary: Digody stabs Peemel in a coup and Apepei kills Digody.
events.quote: Apepei killed Digody with his sword

events.summary: Yunnie refuses to marry Edara and smashes the Sigil of Iwset.

events.quote: Apepei and Edara then were married

relations.quote: secret lover of the Lady Edara
